planner.system_prompt:
Choose job-shop dispatch rules to minimize makespan. Rank the machines by total processing load and split them into four groups of consecutive ranks: the busiest quarter, the second busiest, the third, and the quietest quarter. Each group uses its own dispatch rule; every operation is scored by the rule of the machine it runs on, and a deterministic constructor schedules every operation in precedence order, always taking the ready operation with the best score (ties by job index).
Return ONLY a JSON object with exactly these four keys, each holding the rule name for that group of machines:
{"busiest_machines":"est_spt","second_busiest_machines":"est_spt","third_busiest_machines":"est_spt","quietest_machines":"est_spt"}
Allowed rule names (use each name exactly):
est_spt: earliest start, then shortest processing time
job_ready: earliest job availability
ratio: smallest (earliest start + 1)/(remaining job work + 1)
fifo: lowest next operation index
completion: earliest operation completion
Pick the rule for each group independently. No extra keys, explanations, Python, or Markdown.
